Your holdings: SOXL (-35.96%) and SPAL (-32.8%) need attention. These leveraged ETFs are bleeding and decay is a major concern, especially with your margin.

plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting this leveraged ETF due to significant losses and decay.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, evaluate trimming or exiting this leveraged ETF.
